blocks.html: Christmas Season in the Philippines is never complete without the dazzling glow of lanterns and nowhere does this tradition shine the brightest than in San Fernando, Pampanga, where the world-renowned Giant Lantern Festival is celebrated every year.

blocks.cap: Last year’s competing lanterns lit up San Fernando, Pampanga

blocks.html: The countdown to the country’s favorite Season begins as Robinsons Land Corporation’s lifestyle center in Pampanga, Robinsons Starmills, kicks off the Holiday tradition on September 4, 2025. Robinsons Starmills is again the official partner of the 2025 Giant Lantern Festival, continuing more than 17 years of partnership with the esteemed institution.

blocks.cap: Robinsons Starmills sets the stage for Christmas with its dazzling 35-foot parol-inspired tree.

blocks.html: The festivities open with a Memorandum of Agreement signing to reaffirm the strong partnership behind the event, followed by the launch of the 100 Days Countdown to the Giant Lantern Festival, setting the stage for a season filled with lights, culture, and history.

blocks.cap: Robinsons Land Corporation, the Giant Lantern Festival Foundation, Inc., and the City of San Fernando, Pampanga reaffirm their partnership.

blocks.html: To mark the occasion, Robinsons Starmills lights up its 35-foot Pampanga Lantern-inspired Christmas Tree, adorned with vibrant parols and a grand giant lantern display, paying homage to San Fernando’s reputation as the Christmas Capital of the Philippines.

blocks.cap: Spreading joy to the community through gift giving

blocks.html: The celebration also extends to the community, as Robinsons Starmills donates to the City of San Fernando, Pampanga in support of Hon. Mayor Vilma B. Caluag’s “One Tablet, One Student” program. This meaningful initiative is held in line with the 45th anniversary of Robinsons Land Corporation, blending tradition with a commitment to support the future generations.

blocks.cap: Kicking off the holidays with Christmas Tree Lighting

blocks.html: As the festivities unfold, mallgoers can enjoy early holiday shopping with huge discounts at Lacoste, GUESS, Mango Outlet, and Digimap; indulge in comforting meals at Cabalen, Takoyadon, Zus Coffee, Kenny Rogers, and Bo’s Coffee; or spend family time at Robinsons Movieworld, I Sports, and Kidzooona.

blocks.cap: Mayor Vilma Caluag shares her Christmas message

blocks.html: All eyes then turn to the Giant Lantern Festival competition on December 13, where ten barangays will once again light up the night sky with spectacular 20-foot lanterns. The holiday magic continues with the Giant Lantern Display and Exhibition from December 14, 2025, to January 1, 2026.

blocks.cap: Exciting events and activities await at the 2025 Giant Lantern Festival

blocks.html: Begin your Christmas countdown with lights, tradition, and gift-giving only at Robinsons Starmills, the Home of the Giant Lantern Festival.
